messages:
alice_cs: Quick sync 0min - Meridian QBR prep. Renewal in ~6 weeks; main asks: onboarding velocity, renewal risk, and a 60-day pilot for dedicated instances. Need owners for slides and a small appendix on compliance.

miguel_csm: Ill take adoption metrics + top friction points (slide 3). Will compile cohort funnel and NPS highlights.

priya_ops: I can do the enablement experiment plan slide  (A/B checklist + webinar). Also building a short checklist template we can reuse.

mike_compliance: Heads up - Meridian flagged data residency for EU customers. Ill prepare a 1-slide summary of controls and timelines. Could be an exec ask fallback.

 evan_sales: Ill draft the pilot ask and success metrics (cost delta, latency SLO, user impact). Also will pull an executive quote.

sara_eng: Sending recent perf overlay and bug backlog snippet. @infra_bot attach the 30d error-rate graph?

infra_bot: Attached: /graphs/meridian-error-rate-30d.png and /graphs/meridian-cpu-30d.png

miguel_csm: Data note: activation drops after the third integration step. We should highlight which integrations are most requested (Zendesk, Segment).

priya_ops: Proposed mitigation: two-week targeted onboarding push + in-app checklist A/B test. Measurement: time-to-first-success and 14d retention lift.

alice_cs: Dry run suggested: Wed 9am PT next week. If that works, final slides due Tue EOD.

ev an_sales: Wed works for me. Will post draft asks by Mon so we can iterate.

sara_eng: Ill add an appendix with hotfix ETAs and show estimated impact on activation if we ship them pre-pilot.

mike_compliance: Will include required artifacts for EU customers and an estimated delivery window. If we need legal signoff, flag now.

miguel_csm: Action items (paste into your notes):
```
- alice_cs: schedule dry run + collate final deck link (due Tue EOD)
- miguel_csm: final adoption slide + top 3 friction bullets (due Mon 5pm PT)
- priya_ops: A/B checklist plan + webinar outline (due Mon 5pm PT)
- evan_sales: pilot ask + success metrics + quote (due Mon 5pm PT)
- sara_eng: perf slides + buglet appendix (due Tue 12pm PT)
- mike_compliance: compliance slide + any signoff blockers (due Tue 12pm PT)
```

alice_cs: Also: collect 3 anonymized customer feedback snippets for the readout. Miguel, can you pull from support tickets?

miguel_csm: Yep  will pull and scrub identifiers, post Wed morning.

priya_ops: For the A/B test: small sample (n~120) per arm should surface a signal in 10 days. Will include dashboard queries.

sara_eng: Noted. If the A/B shows >6% lift in 14d retention, we recommend rolling to all new signups.

ev an_sales: I'll prep a one-page success-case scenario we can present to Meridian execs.

alice_cs: Great  thanks all. Ill drop the deck link and calendar invite shortly. Ping me if you hit data permission walls. :thumbsup:
